paragraphs.text: I am a third-year master's student at
Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University
in the IVG@SZ group. I am currently a research intern on the

team, working on long-document pretraining data and the knowledge work agent. Before that, I received my B.S. in Electric and Electronic Engineering from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) in 2024.
My research interests lie in computer vision, including
large vision-language models, tool-calling, multimodal learning, segmentation, and tracking
Academic service: conference reviewer for ICCV, AAAI, and CVPR; journal reviewer for TPAMI, TIP, and TMM.
